name: Driftmark Tier-Skip Courier's Full Haul Kit
description: A deliberately ambiguous head-to-toe kit designed for a courier who moves between all five tiers daily without triggering pattern recognition. The base is a fitted charcoal poly-merino long-sleeve with modular magnetic attachment points along the shoulders and forearms. Over it: a reversible mid-layer — one side matte Circuit-worker grey, the other muted Tier-4 slate with subtle sheen. Slim graphite cargo trousers with concealed ankle gussets for leg chrome or tail accommodation. Clean low-profile black cross-trainers, scuff-resistant. A collapsible satchel compresses to a courier pouch or expands to a full delivery frame. A nondescript ballcap with AR-transparent brim completes the look — forgettable in every tier.
functionality: Reversible mid-layer allows rapid tier-presentation shift; magnetic shoulder mounts accept branded patch sets for delivery company IDs; gusseted ankle seams accommodate leg chrome or geneware; AR-transparent cap brim overlays route data via BCI; satchel frame collapses flat in under four seconds.
what_it_says: I belong everywhere and nowhere — don't look too hard.
worn_by: fixers running errands in plain sight
undercover operatives maintaining cover across multiple zones
story_hooks: A courier wearing this kit is the only witness to a Tier-5 assassination — and every tier's security system has a different description of what they looked like.
The reversible mid-layer's Tier-4 side bears a defunct corponation's color — one that was dissolved under suspicious circumstances three weeks ago.
A Driftmark patch sewn into the satchel lining turns out to be a dead-drop data chip that the courier has been unknowingly carrying for six months.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately neutral, forgettable silhouette designed for cross-tier anonymity. Lean and functional without drawing attention—neither aspirational nor visibly struggling. The modular construction creates subtle visual interest without standing out.
physical_description.fit: Fitted through the torso with tailored taper at wrists and ankles. Slim cargo trousers with no excess fabric. Compression-adjacent without being athletic. Designed to accommodate augmentations (chrome limbs, tail rigs, subcutaneous tech) without obvious adjustments.
physical_description.primary_material: Charcoal poly-merino base layer, Circuit-worker grade ballistic weave mid-layer (reversible), graphite ripstop cargo fabric, scuff-resistant synthleather crosstrainers, recycled nylon satchel with magnetic attachment webbing
physical_description.texture: Base layer has subtle ribbed texture. Mid-layer reverses from matte (grey side) to soft pearl-finish (slate side). Cargo fabric shows tight weave with reinforced stress points. Cap brim incorporates flexible AR-mesh—barely perceptible to touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant: charcoal, graphite, slate grey. Accents: matte black (shoes, zippers). No branding visible. Deliberately desaturated palette—colors that exist in every tier without signaling wealth or poverty.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snaps on modular shoulder/forearm attachment points. YKK friction-lock zippers on cargo pockets (silent operation). Magnetic closure on collapsible satchel. Cap secured with friction-fit adjustable band.
distinctive_features: Modular magnetic attachment points along shoulders and forearms for tool/data exchange
Reversible mid-layer (Circuit-worker grey vs. Tier-4 slate)
Concealed ankle gussets for cybernetic leg accommodation
Collapsible satchel expands/compresses via magnetic frame skeleton
AR-transparent cap brim—designed to work with neural overlays without obstruction
Reinforced stress points at wrists, knees, ankles
No visible branding or tier signifiers
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional aesthetic with Tier 1 modular engineering. Deliberately unmarked—signals 'working professional' across all tiers without revealing economic status.
physical_description.cultural_context: Courier culture. Inter-tier mobility. Someone who needs to be invisible and trusted everywhere. Movement through restricted zones. Likely carries sensitive data or packages. No corp affiliation visible—independent operator or neutral third-party logistics.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in depending on assignment length. Expected to show minor scuffs on shoes and satchel after 2-3 weeks active use. Synthetic materials resist staining. Designed to maintain professional appearance under harsh conditions.
